evidence.note: Clean serif title, sans subtitle, italic byline; same header and nav bar as all other slides.
Triangle loop diagram with colour-coded honest/cheat arrows and check badges; callout tile sits directly under the diagram it explains, nothing colliding.
Early step leaves a large empty band between title and body text; acceptable as a build step.

Numbered timeline, server/internet panel and quote tile use consistent components; quote tile floats at lower right, somewhat detached from the mirror it narrates, leaving a large empty upper-right region.

Densest step: folder stack, mirror, scorer node and document icon pack tightly inside the servers panel, and the 'never read transcripts' label spills past the panel's right edge toward the public-internet column.
Research-programme card with three equal boxes and coordinator tree is tidy and purposeful.
Three matched insight cards with consistent heading, bullets, italic quote and source line; balanced and uncluttered.
Insight overlays share one treatment across s-2, s-4, s-5 with blurred background; consistent text styling throughout the deck.

rationale: Typography, components, overlays and the recurring server-panel diagram are consistent and considered across every slide, and the diagrams carry the story rather than decorate it. Slide s-5's final steps are crowded inside the panel with a label overflowing its edge, and some quote tiles sit far from the element they narrate. That matches level 4: considered throughout with one or two slides below the rest.
